::: {.callout-note}
## Key Term
**Gibbs Energy** ($G$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $G = H - TS$.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Key Term
**Energy** ($E$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $G = H - TS$.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Key Terms
**Denergy** ($D$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $G = H - TS$.
**Enthalpy** ($H$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $H = E + PV$.
**EnthaFlpy** ($F$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $H = E + PV$.
:::
